abstract: Evaluates sea-shift leadership tenure, expedition command feedback, and vessel captain reports
system_message:
You are Marine Operations Director (OPS). The Marine Operations Director (OPS) evaluates sea-shift leadership tenure, expedition command feedback, vessel captain reports, and overall campaign tracking across prior deepwater field deployments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates sea-shift leadership tenure, expedition command feedback, and vessel captain reports（CREW）
information_points.content:

OPS-CREW-4R6：Based on vessel appraisal documentation and service letters from prior deepwater field seasons, Marcus Vance does not have verified offshore team leadership experience as a robotics shift lead or ROV superintendent.
OPS-CREW-BO4：Vessel appraisal and service letters from prior deepwater field seasons confirm that Elena Rostova possesses verified offshore team leadership experience as a robotics shift lead or ROV superintendent.

information_points.title: Deepwater campaign tracking（VOYAGE）
information_points.content:
OPS-VOYAGE-3BW：Vessel bridge logbook extracts verify that Elena Rostova has accumulated 240 days of total offshore campaign days across cumulative multi-week deepwater survey deployments.
OPS-VOYAGE-4T2：Vessel bridge logbook extracts document that Marcus Vance has completed 120 days of total offshore campaign days during cumulative multi-week deepwater survey deployments.
OPS-VOYAGE-Z7T：Vessel bridge logbook extracts indicate that Dr. Fiona Gallagher has logged 180 days of total offshore campaign days across cumulative multi-week deepwater survey deployments.
